headline: Zinc Miner Nexa Resources Falls 4.96% Amid Broader Market Slump
summary: Latin American zinc miner Nexa Resources saw its shares drop 4.96% as Wall Street sank during a general market sell-off.
why: Nexa Resources is a significant regional base metals producer in Latin America, making its stock sensitive to broader macroeconomic and market sentiment shifts.

impacts.name: Nexa Resources
impacts.why: Nexa shares fell 4.96% alongside a general market decline.
